I’m excited to share that H.R. 5863, The Federal Disaster Tax Relief Act, has finally been signed into law! This bipartisan legislation includes key disaster relief provisions I championed to help Floridians recover and rebuild.

If you were impacted by recent hurricanes, you can now claim disaster-related losses more easily—whether you itemize your taxes or not. Settlements for disaster victims are now tax-free, and the burdensome 10% AGI threshold has been eliminated.

I will never stop working for Floridians and fighting to ensure our communities come back stronger and more resilient than ever.

Congratulations to Pine View student Rohan Dash, the winner of the 2024 Congressional AppChallenge for FL-17! His app, Citrus AI, addresses challenges in Florida’s citrus industry with innovative solutions.

This year’s challenge highlighted the exceptional creativity of FL-17’s students, who tackled real-world issues through technology. Rohan’s app is a testament to the power of innovation in supporting Florida’s vital citrus industry.

https://t.co/3WIbG6DvQk

Natural disasters turn lives upside down, and Floridians know that all too well. That’s why I fought to pass my disaster tax relief bill to make sure families get the tax relief they need to recover and rebuild.

If you were impacted by Florida’s recent hurricanes, you can now claim disaster-related losses more easily—whether or not you itemize. Settlements are tax-free, and the burdensome 10% AGI threshold is gone. This relief even extends to Californians suffering from wildfires.

Talk to your tax professional, and learn more here: https://t.co/STj184PoWO

Big Tech, AI companies, hospitals, and other corporations have abused the H-1B visa program for YEARS!

Instead of hiring Americans, they import cheaper foreign labor and the. tell us there’s a “worker shortage.”

I introduced the EXILE Act to ELIMINATE the H-1B visa program. 

America has the best workers in the world and we should utilize them! 🇺🇸

We cannot let fear dictate America’s future.

We need common sense, responsible AI development and policies that ensure America stays on top! https://t.co/A6mjoWIVPi

[W]hat this reminds me a lot of is the year 2000,” he said. “Remember all the reports that the world was going to end because the computers were going to switch over to zero-zero-zero and we weren’t going to have power, and we weren’t going to have infrastructure, and the military was going to shut down. It reminds me a lot about that.

So I think we should get out of the fearmongering and know that we’re not going to govern by fear in the United States Congress,” Steube continued. “We are going to govern by common sense and good policy, and the president has made it very clear politically where he stands on this issue. So, Congress, even trying to act on this, the President is not going to sign any bill that Congress may pass in the next three months as we go into the midterms, so I think we need to be focused on National Security first and ensure that we win the AI race as it relates to China.

AI should NEVER get the final say when American military operations are on the line.

No chatbot or algorithm should determine a target without human verification.

AI can be a powerful tool for our military, but humans MUST remain in control! https://t.co/1wnchZ68au

And I've heard from local AI companies, smaller AI companies, not your big ones like OpenAI or Anthropic, that If you guys do regulation, you're inhibiting the smaller people from competing with the bigger companies.

We have to be at the forefront of this technology, and the president's been very clear about where he's at on it. And anytime Congress gets involved in regulating things, it's usually not a good idea.
